title: One-Way Wizard

upstream.known_validation_gap: Wave2 success does not mechanically require Redirect/Split; fresh-cast dominance has not been ruled out. The playable proceeds specifically to measure whether transformations are desirable in human play.

interaction_principles: Fixed60Hz rules own time; presentation follows.
Separate movement and retained aim; explicit single-shot CAST/REDIRECT/SPLIT.
Conditional validation gap stays visible; no gameplay coercion invented.

accessibility: Minimum44px hit areas; text>=16px,4.5:1 contrast; shape plus color distinguish Bolt,pulse,enemy; labels on buttons.
Reduced motion suppresses screen shake/long trails while keeping heading/wrap cues and unchanged clock.

input_contract.scaling: Uniform fit after safe-area insets; inverse-transform pointers to logical reference px before hit-testing. Aspect ratio preserved.

policies.button_tap: Commit only on pointer-up inside original control, max displacement<=12px and duration<=500ms inclusive. Leaving bound or exceeding either threshold permanently cancels gesture. No release fallback to CAST.
policies.priority: Modal/navigation > buttons > pad region > arena/background. First pointer in each pad owns that pad until release; movement and aiming may use different pointers simultaneously; one pointer cannot own two controls. Additional pointers on already captured control are ignored.
policies.duplicate: Each (pointer_id,sequence_id) release consumed once; a later distinct sequence is a new gesture.
policies.presentation: Real-time rule clock continues at frozen60Hz during casts, trails, impact and transform animation. Presentation never gates input or advances timers. No cooldown invented by UI. Only Pause and terminal result block gameplay.
policies.pause: Pause immediately freezes rule clock/timers; zero movement and cancel active pointer captures/pending taps. Resume preserves rule state and retained aim but requires fresh pointer down; stale releases ignored. Focus loss enters same Pause.
policies.terminal: Authoritative result blocks gameplay immediately, zeros movement, cancels captures and shows Result. No fabricated clear/failure condition.
policies.retry: Production retry restores fixed WAVE2_INITIAL, resets UI aim0, zero move, clears pending pointer sequences, transient trails and input observer history; never wave1.
policies.input_invalid: Disabled CAST/tool buttons remain readable with reason: mana/cooldown/cap/no charge. Production validator rechecks at release. Invalid input creates no cast/pulse and no cost; time may still advance independently in live play.
policies.simulation_test_mode: Fixtures use existing deterministic manual debug_step clock. Synthetic gestures dispatch input events without secretly stepping simulation; duration parameter is recognizer metadata. debug_step uses production60Hz update. Interactive production continues automatic clock. Tests compare rule snapshots before explicit steps and may use existing fixtures only.

hooks.debug_tap(position:Vector2)->bool: Generate80ms pointer down/up via production input router; true only on committed enabled UI action.
hooks.debug_drag(path:Array[Vector2],duration:: Feed timed down/move/up production events; duration seconds. Movement lasts while pointer held and zeros on release.
hooks.debug_pointer(event:Dictionary)->bool: Production router with logical position Vector2,phase down/move/up/cancel,pointer_id int,sequence_id int,time_ms int. True for recognized valid event; callers observe snapshots for semantic outcome.
hooks.debug_ui_snapshot()->Dictionary: Read-only screen,aim_degrees,move_vector,pointer_capture_count,dispatch_history (accepted cast/tool dictionaries and navigation events); history reset on fixture load/retry. No production state mutation. dispatch_history entries use type='cast'|'redirect'|'split' and angle_degrees for accepted semantic calls; navigation entries use type='navigation'.
hooks.debug_load_fixture(name:String): Existing rule setup hook; synchronize UI to Arena ready, reset aim0/captures/history; fixture definitions unchanged.
hooks.debug_step(seconds:float): Existing production fixed-clock hook; no render-clock substitution.

input_contract.test_result_fixture_policy: Use TEST_CONTACT from RULE contract, repeating exact60-tick intervals until authoritative HP0 within a bounded loop. Use existing WAVE2_INITIAL for retry. No test-only terminal setter.
